decision_rules.PASS: All required source, path, content, UI/API/artifact, workflow, and gate evidence is complete and consistent for the exact tested SHA.
decision_rules.FAIL: A verified integrity or consistency invariant is violated.
decision_rules.HOLD: Required source provenance or evidence is missing, ambiguous, stale, or cannot be independently verified.

known_findings.finding: File content is only UTF-8 BOM bytes at candidate and parent commit.
known_findings.disposition: Restore from trusted source revision; do not synthesize replacement.

known_findings.finding: Earlier CI Lite reported NUL bytes; later candidate commit replaced the file.
known_findings.disposition: Re-run byte-level scan and regression tests on current candidate.

known_findings.finding: Referenced source-history anchors were not verifiable in the target checkout during Baseline Truth Gate.
known_findings.disposition: Verify the source repository/history and provenance; do not replace anchors with candidate SHA.

known_findings.finding: CI Lite and V3.5 production-readiness checks fail on candidate; Exact-SHA gate passing is not sufficient evidence of complete workflow coverage.
known_findings.disposition: Inspect failing job logs and reconcile all workflow inputs and checked-out SHAs.

non_goals: Do not convert expected authorization denials into success responses.
Do not disable or weaken failing gates.
Do not infer a file's identity from basename alone.
Do not treat a green subset of workflows as overall PASS.
